title: DOTr eyes to bid out LRT-2, MRT-3 ops to private sector in 2027
summary: The Department of Transportation (DOTr) is planning to bid out the operations and maintenance of the Metro Rail Transit Line 3 (MRT-3) and Light Rail Transit Line 2 (LRT-2) to the private sector in…

blocks.text: The Department of Transportation (DOTr) is planning to bid out the operations and maintenance of the Metro Rail Transit Line 3 (MRT-3) and Light Rail Transit Line 2 (LRT-2) to the private sector in 2027.

In his remarks at Stratbase Institute's Pilipinas Conference 2026 in Makati City on Friday, Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said the DOTr is looking to solicit bids for the private sector's takeover of LRT-2 "next year."
The solicited public-private partnership (PPP) for LRT-2 is being done "with assistance from the International Finance Corp. of the World Bank."
The plan to hand over the operations and maintenance of MRT-3 will also be done through a solicited bidding in the coming year, according to Dizon.
The Transportation chief said the solicited PPP for MRT-3 is being done "with support from the Asian Development Bank."

Moreover, he said the DOTr is eyeing a PPP for the automated fare collection system covering the country's major railway networks, including the Metro Manila Subway and the North-South Commuter Railway "early next year."

In his remarks, Dizon also announced the upcoming opening of major toll road projects, such as the Cavite-Laguna Expressway (CALAX) and the first phase of the Toll Road 4 (TR4) connecting Laguna to Lucena.

The CALAX is already 97% complete and is expected to be inaugurated by President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. before Christmas. The Kawit segment connecting CALAX to the Manila-Cavite Expressway (CAVITEX) is already open.
Meanwhile, Toll Road 4 (TR4) is expected to open early next year. — VDV, GMA News
